why_best: This visual reset signals a complete editorial pivot between major news segments while preserving the anchor team's calm, credible presence.
why_bad: A direct hard cut or high-energy wipe would feel aggressive and disrupt the viewer's comprehension of the shift in topic.
trap: A near-miss will cross-contaminate the visual content by blurring the outgoing and incoming headlines together simultaneously rather than resolving through a clean intermediate stage.
